== English Virtual Original comparison ==
Early cancellation applies to Dark side site text where Bron is present with docking bay transit excepted. Later cancellation explicitly excludes docking bay sites as a whole. The free Blaster Rifle deployment disappears, the named rifle still fires for free, and attrition immunity now requires a Blaster Rifle. Two earlier papers and true 2006 issuer slip are distinct. The installed V17 GIF repeats later Virtual Block 1 text rather than the actual 2006 Original Virtual full face; it supplies no additional Set 5 game state.
